It negates effects that read, "reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by X," like  and [BT3-103 Hidden Potential Discovered!].Even if your opponent activates effects like these, it won't reduce the memory cost of their digivolutions. They have to pay the digivolution cost on the card in order to digivolve.

My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I activate  on a card in my hand, will I be able to reduce digivolution costs with it?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes. [BT2-111 Beelzemon]'s effect doesn't reduce digivolution costs--it allows you to ignore digivolution requirements and digivolve for a specific memory cost, so you can still activate it.
